intendedUse: Normalize a current Hungarian four-digit postcode, retrieve its rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon through the AGID API, fit the map and show a translucent context area with source, reference date, classification and confidence.
recordGrain: one current Magyar Posta four-digit assignment, its special/non-geographic classification and its truthful real area or unavailable result

m2Definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Magyar Posta nationwide four-digit assignment denominator with special, PO-box and dedicated-code classification, and either an authoritative postal-area Polygon/MultiPolygon or a rights-cleared postcode-membership-derived surface with complete members, exclusions, method and uncertainty, are pinned by edition, validity, terms, CRS, SHA-256 and coverage, published as an approved immutable artifact, and pass the real HU loader, API and app search-to-translucent-area path. Partner Extra rows without special classification or area geometry, GISCO or TERCET points and NUTS matches, KSH administrative polygons, KCR address points, buildings or parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, synthetic fixtures and invented non-geographic surfaces never satisfy M2.

officialObservations.finding: Magyar Posta calls Partner Extra a public service available to everyone, says its XML files may be downloaded and used as an application background database, and links ZipCodes as settlement-to-postcode data. The page exposes no postcode-area Polygon/MultiPolygon or special-code class field.

The official schema defines ZipCodes.xml with only Code, city and TimeWindowID and says the database updates daily. It supplies assignment data but no geometry, source CRS, area membership or explicit special/PO-box/dedicated-code classification.

The current XML contains 3,817 unique four-character Code rows with nonblank city values. Sixteen codes preserve a leading zero. There are no geometry or special-class fields, so the file cannot establish an area or distinguish non-geographic endpoints for M2.

The official KCR regulation defines address elements, coordinates, unique address and property identifiers, and automated transfer to named authorities and the universal postal operator. Recipient bodies may not independently provide or forward the transferred data. KCR is not an anonymous public postcode-polygon release.

KSH publishes administrative and statistical units, settlement records and postcode attributes. Its map levels are region, county, district, settlement and grids; these are context, not postal-membership perimeters.

GISCO describes CC BY-SA 4.0 postal-code point data made for NUTS correspondence. Non-geographic codes may be absent and locations or coverage may be incomplete; points and NUTS matches are not Magyar Posta perimeters.

The HU row records 1 member-state postal-dataset code, 3,125 address-derived codes, 30 GeoNames codes, zero GISCO-2020 carryovers and zero manually located codes, totalling 3,156. The methodology warns that locations and coverage are imperfect and non-geographic codes are inconsistent.
The ZIP contains one CSV with only NUTS3 and CODE columns. It has 3,156 unique valid four-digit codes after stripping the single-quote text wrapper and no coordinates or geometry.

comparison.implication: The public TERCET correspondence cannot replace the current Magyar Posta denominator and neither artifact supplies area geometry.

dataQuality.risk: The current 3,817-row Magyar Posta XML is unique, format-valid and fresh, but it has neither special-code classification nor geometry. TERCET is a smaller point/NUTS correspondence with a different code set and cannot become the current denominator or a postal surface.

browserReview.reason: No real rights-cleared HU Polygon/MultiPolygon exists to exercise. Deterministic shared UI tests verify capability without presenting synthetic geometry as Hungarian M2 evidence.

pdfReview.finding: The visible table layout and Hungary row match the extracted 1, 3125, 30, 0, 0 and 3156 values without clipping or overlap.

visualizationDecision.reason: An exact authority and geometry audit matrix communicates the one-country binary gate more faithfully than a chart, and no spatial surface exists to map.

blockerSummary: Magyar Posta exposes a fresh 3,817-row assignment XML, but it lacks special/non-geographic classification and all area geometry. TERCET 2025 has 3,156 point/NUTS correspondence codes and no geometry; KSH units are administrative, while KCR address coordinates are controlled and cannot be independently forwarded. No rights-cleared real HU Polygon/MultiPolygon or approved immutable area artifact exists.
unblockConditions: Obtain or publish an authoritative current Magyar Posta nationwide four-digit denominator with explicit special, PO-box and dedicated-code classification, edition, effective date, terms, bytes and SHA-256.

Obtain an authoritative postal-area Polygon/MultiPolygon release or a rights-cleared derived surface whose complete address membership, exclusions, method, uncertainty and correction process are auditable; do not use points, administration, parcels, buildings, buffers or Voronoi cells as substitutes.

Pin CRS, coverage, validity, terms, attribution and SHA-256, publish an approved immutable artifact without personal, cadastral or land-right data, and preserve official, derived, virtual and unavailable classifications.
Pass real HU normalization, loader, API, geometry validation, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
